reasons: Wrong quantity: container.blockio.io_service_time_recursive measures blkio service time in ns, not bytes written, so it cannot stand in for docker.io.write_bytes.
Unit mismatch: the candidate's metric is in ns, while the Datadog query is in bytes.
The operation="write" filter selects a different series set (service time per operation) rather than the bytes-written total.
No OTel metric in the definitions measures bytes written. The correct outcome is blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING unless a bytes-written metric is found in the dataset.
The candidate is translated although no exact mapping exists, so the outcome is wrong. Grouping by container_image_name is plausible but unverified, since no dataset_labels were provided.
